data.name: Totally Normal Ramen
data.detailed_description:
The salaryman aliens flock to your ramen spaceship from all across the galaxy. They are hungry and eagerly awaiting for your kitchen to open!

Totally Normal Ramen is a first-person, atmospheric, outer space, restaurant simulation where your goal is to operate your ramen spaceship efficiently. As the sole cook in a deep space food spaceship, you must balance the relentless demand of serving your customers, ensuring you have enough dishware to do so, and maintaining a stocked fridge with the freshest ingredients.

OPERATE THE KITCHEN

There is always a hungry customer somewhere. Open your store and they will arrive! Are you ready to take on what it takes to operate a space ship ramen store?

  • Take Orders: Process incoming requests from a diverse array of extraterrestrial salarymen, each with specific, often bizarre, culinary requirements.

  • Clean Dishware: Bowls are a commodity in deep space. Wash the bowl before serving the next customer! Nobody wants to eat out of a dirty bowl.

  • Manage Resources: Success is in the details. Monitor your supply levels, and restock the fridge before the next rush arrives.

  • Be Wary of Dangers: Who said deep space is all peace and quiet? Shoot your way out when the time comes.

KEY FEATURES

  • Extraterrestrial Customers: Learn their strange habits and satisfy their otherworldly appetites before they lose their patience.

  • Space Exploration: Travel across the galaxy with energy and discover different planets, customers and events!

  • Varied Mini Games: Complete tasks by playing various mini games with easy objectives.

Will you rise as the galaxy’s ultimate ramen chef.. or get lost in the chaos of space?

data.short_description: Cook ramen across the galaxy as a rogue robot chef! Explore planets, trigger wild events, battle dangerous customers, and build your ultimate space food truck.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 2-core 1.7 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060, Radeon RX 480 XT or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 807 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: 4-core 2.9 GHz or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 2060, Radeon RX 560 XT or similar
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
